claims.claim_ar: استخدام الفاء الفصيحة لربط الجملة وإضفاء ربطٍ مباشر ووظيفي بين الطلب والبيان التالي.
claims.claim_en: Use of the emphatic 'fa' (al-fa' al-fasiha) to link the clause, giving a direct, emphatic connection between the request and the following statement.
claims.rhetorical_effect: creates immediacy and smooth linkage between speech turns; emphasizes continuity of the narrative/request

claims.claim_ar: استعمال إنَّ مع خبر مُعزَّز بلام التوكيد (اللام المزحلقة) لتوكيد الضمان والاعتداد: «إِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ».
claims.claim_en: Use of 'inna' with a reinforced predicate (with the emphatic 'lam' — lam al-mazhalaq) to emphasize assurance and firm guarantee: 'inna lahu lahafizun'.
claims.rhetorical_effect: conveys strong assurance and trustworthiness, intensifying the brothers' claim of guardianship

claims.claim_ar: استعمال صيغة الأمر (أرسل) كآلية بلاغية للطلب والتوسّل في إعادة الصغير مع المتكلم.
claims.claim_en: Use of the imperative form (arsil) as a rhetorical device for requesting/entreaty to send the youth with them.
claims.rhetorical_effect: frames the speaker's stance as active/requesting, making the plea more direct and persuasive
